notes.title: Super Hoopers - Update #11
notes.content:
Patch Notes 30/01/2024


 Reworked the aiming system, dragging won't longer stop abruptly as soon as the mouse cursor reaches the screen limits.
 The crosshair no longer hides behind other textures and props.
 Fixed not being able to go past City Level 9 upon completion.
 The "Learner" achievement should now unlock properly after completing the tutorials levels.


Thank you for your reviews and for reporting the mentioned issues! ːAviciiPixelHeartː

If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks!

notes.title: Super Hoopers - Update #9
notes.content:
Patch Notes 23/02/2023

 Added 'Aim Mode' dropdown in the 'Options' menu.

- Default: Inverted (Similar to Angry Birds, Trajectory is shown inverse to mouse position).

- Forward: Non-Inverted (Trajectory is shown relative to mouse position).


If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks!

If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks!

notes.title: Super Hoopers - Update #7
notes.content:
Patch Notes 07/02/2023


 Improved detection of the basket triggers, issues like scoring and the game not detecting the win should no longer occur. (or atleast happen way less often)

 Better performance when the trajectory is shown while dragging and aiming before throwing.

 Added 'FPS Limit' dropdown in the 'Settings' menu, default is '300' (recommended).

 Added icons in the 'Level Select' menu to display which levels are currently locked.

 You can now press numeric keys aswell rather than just the numpad (for secret reasons). Thanks kitt!

 Fixed other smaller issues.


If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks!

notes.title: Super Hoopers - Update #6
notes.content:
Patch Notes 05/02/2023

 Completely reworked the Save system (Savegame data is now stored in a file rather than using Windows registry, thanks to Richard Elms @ https://github.com/richardelms/FileBasedPlayerPrefs)

 Added a button allowing the player to reset the game progress (found in: Main Menu -> Options -> Reset Progress)

 Countdown now begins when the player has pressed the mouse button for the first time rather than immediately after loading the level.

 Screen now properly adjusts depending on the resolution player is using.

 Ingame music now properly fades in and out rather than playing inmediately.

 Added a reminder text specifying that you are able to quickly restart by pressing the "R" key without needing to pause and press the reload icon.

If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks.

notes.title: Super Hoopers Update #5
notes.content:
Patch Notes 02/02/2023

 Second monitor screen no longer turns black if the player is using a two monitor setup.
 Fixed an issue that caused the player animation to play when unpausing the game.
 Player animation won't longer play infinitely if the ball is thrown and the player keeps pressing the mouse button.
 Various code optimization.
 Vastly reduced the size of the game (Turns out having almost every texture uncompressed isn't optimal for the build size, oops!) 

If you encounter any issue or game breaking glitches, please let me know through the discussion forum! Thanks. ːAviciiPixelHeartː
